sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-ORB3 key (RB-ORB3) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base first barracks armories.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Required for the quest Reserve Expert from Ragman

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Front passenger seat of the Tigr vehicle closest to the bridge.

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In different locations in the main room on the first floor of the barracks marked with white pawn.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: East barracks on Reserve. North end of the eastern building, 2nd floor. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 3 Weapon racks (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
- Two Drawers
